acceptance_criteria: The deck leads the hiring audience through role fit, selected contribution evidence, outcomes, and a clear next decision rather than mirroring document headings.
Each slide has one claim, source and visual bindings are auditable, and notes preserve evidence limits, confidentiality, and speaking cues.
